pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, rounded polygonal regions with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area is medium-sized on the neck and increases in horizontal elongation along the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space with a moderate pixel thickness. Junction nodes consist primarily of three-way intersections creating a reticulated topology across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark brown mane exhibiting low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness along the upper neck and shoulder silhouette.
